profile_text.body:
Greylock Partners is a venture capital firm based in Menlo Park, California, founded in 1965. According to its website, the firm describes itself as "a leading venture capital firm based in Silicon Valley" that serves as "early partners of remarkable teams building companies that matter." The firm limits its investment activity, with each Greylock partner making only one or two new investments per year, bringing what it characterizes as full attention, network, and resources to every partnership.

The company operates in California, where it faces law exposure across 220 cases in the state. Greylock Partners maintains no tracked AI products or MCP server registrations in the site's current database.
